$comment: Front matter schema for lessons (lesson-map/1). The 54 existing lessons are JS objects in js/content/*.js; data/lesson-map.json carries the front matter beside them until lessons move to Markdown. Checked by scripts/validate_lessons.mjs.

properties.key: string, '<track id>/<lesson id>', must match js/content/*.js
properties.title: string, must equal the lesson title
properties.level: integer 0-10 (Course map; recommended, never a lock)
properties.python_min: string 'X.Y', lowest CPython the lesson works on (baseline 3.13)
properties.minutes: integer, as in the lesson file
properties.outcomes: array of >=1 'I can ...' phrases (written without the 'I can')
properties.sources: array of >=1 ids from js/content/sources.js, equal to the lesson's own list
properties.last_verified: null or 'YYYY-MM-DD': date a human last re-checked facts and ran the code
